title: Offer Reason
description: Why a seller made an offer against an accepted media buy. Experimental in AdCP 3.3 (media_buy.seller_offers). The value is a routing hint; the offered commercial_terms are the authoritative change.

enumDescriptions.installment_postponed: A scheduled installment (episode, creator post, or broadcast) cannot run on its agreed date. The offer proposes a new date, a substitute installment, or a credit.
enumDescriptions.installment_cancelled: A scheduled installment will not run. The offer proposes a replacement installment, a credit, or a negotiated cancellation of the affected scope.
enumDescriptions.preemption: Booked inventory was preempted, typically linear broadcast. The offer proposes replacement inventory; once accepted and aired, the replacement is reported as a by_spot row carrying replaces_spot_id.
enumDescriptions.under_delivery: The seller forecasts that the buy will miss its committed volume. The offer proposes a remedy such as a flight extension, a budget move to another product, bonus units, or a makegood.
enumDescriptions.seller_request: The seller needs different terms for a reason that none of the other values names. Use sparingly; the proposal name and description explain the change.
